activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle
Setting up the computer workstation and reviewing the day's patient schedule
Working from home as a health care professional, conducting telehealth consultations and updating patient records on the computer (no commute due to the transport strike)
Preparing and eating lunch, reheating food in the microwave

Resuming remote health care work, following up with patients and completing administrative tasks on the computer
Tidying up the living room and vacuuming the floor
Resting and changing into comfortable clothes
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and range hood
Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
Taking an evening shower and drying off
Leisure time, browsing the phone and watching TV
Winding down, turning off the lamp and preparing for bed
